# Performance Engineering
Establish a reproducible baseline where possible. Inspect startup, scripts, DOM updates, listener use, IndexedDB, sync volume, network calls, and GAS quotas. Prefer targeted fixes and regression tests. Do not optimize protected QR code automatically or sacrifice correctness for minor speed gains.
